name: UpdateDataTableItemNode
label: Update Data Table Item
description: Updates a specific cell in a DataTable by specifying the column, row, and new value.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The DataTable containing the data to be updated.

fields.name: Column
fields.label: Column
fields.description: The name of the column where the update should occur.

fields.name: Row
fields.label: Row
fields.description: The row index or primary key value of the row to update.

fields.name: NewValue
fields.label: New Value
fields.description: The new value to set for the specified cell.

fields.name: ModifiedDataTable
fields.label: Modified Data Table
fields.description: The DataTable after the specified cell has been updated.
